lines.en: I advance in slow, heavy strides.

lines.zh: 我身上的金属互相摩擦。
lines.en: The metal on me grinds together.

lines.zh: 我一步踩下去，地面轻震。
lines.en: Each step makes the ground quiver.
I walk slowly toward you.

lines.zh: 我身上的沙漏，还在往下漏。
lines.en: The hourglass in me keeps draining.
I circle along the edge.
I turn my cumbersome body.
Time flows around me.

lines.zh: 我一步一步把距离压短。
lines.en: Step by step I cut the distance.
I look at the sky, then down.
I stand and the clocks on me turn.

lines.zh: 光在我胸甲上缓慢流动。
lines.en: Light moves slowly across my chestplate.
I stand still as a pillar.
I'm calculating how long remains.
Time sits level here.
I raise one arm slowly.
My footsteps have stopped.
I watch you without expression.
There's a faint hum in the air.
I tilt my head slightly.
I've waited long, and I don't tire.

lines.zh: 我的护甲上落了一层灰。
lines.en: A layer of dust has settled on my armor.

lines.zh: 时间一圈一圈地绕着我。
lines.en: Time circles me, loop after loop.
I slowly close my palm.
Everything here has slowed.

lines.zh: 我身上的金属互相摩擦，走得很沉。
lines.en: The metal on me grinds; my steps are heavy.
How much longer will you stand there?

lines.zh: 我低头，看你这个小小的东西。
lines.en: I look down at this small thing you are.
Your time is running out.
I've counted every one of your steps.
You hold your shoulders too tight.

lines.zh: 钟摆在我身后，一秒一秒。
lines.en: The pendulum swings behind me, tick by tick.
Time is welded to my hands.
Before me, you seem very brief.
I've seen others come before you.

lines.zh: 时间在我手里，慢了一拍。
lines.en: Time in my hands runs a beat slow.
I turn the dial to point at you.
I keep the time of this place.
There's a mark on my armor.

lines.zh: 你打中了，可惜早了一秒。
lines.en: You hit me — one second too early.
One step back rewinds a single second.
My casing dented; I still keep time.
I look at where I was struck.
A crack has opened in one of my dials.
I square my body again.
I have recorded this moment.
Time will repair it.
I can continue.

lines.zh: 这东西对时间没有意义。
lines.en: This means nothing to time.

lines.zh: 时间不换东西，我也不换。
lines.en: Time trades for nothing, and neither do I.
I look down at it, then up again.
Taking it does no harm.
I have no appetite for such things.
Set it down and step back.
I'll keep it as a marker.
This will be gone soon enough.

lines.zh: 你给得越多，我越不在意。
lines.en: The more you give, the less I care.

lines.zh: 时间焊上去的东西，放在脚边。
lines.en: What time welded, I set by my feet.
You hit me like a city wall.

lines.zh: 我的护甲没有半点让步。
lines.en: My armor yields nothing.
You stagger several steps before steadying.
I slowly turn my body.

lines.zh: 这点冲撞，我几乎没感觉。
lines.en: That impact barely registered.
Time circles me. I do not move.
The metal-on-metal sound is dull.

lines.zh: 我的影子把你整个罩住。
lines.en: My shadow covers you entirely.
If you want around, go wide.
I hold this path.

lines.zh: 另一具高大的身影靠近。
lines.en: Another tall figure comes near.
Our clocks run equally slow.
We stand together a long while.

lines.zh: 它的盔甲上有同样的纹。
lines.en: Its armor bears the same marks.

lines.zh: 时间在我们之间停了一下。
lines.en: Time paused between us.
I raise a hand; it raises its own.
We watch the sky side by side.
This moment will be recorded.
Time in hand, no words needed.
Long after, we are still here.
I bend and lift it slowly.
I pinch it between two fingers.
Time will wear this away.
I tuck it into a seam of my armor.
I look at it; it means little.

lines.zh: 它在我手里发凉，时间的齿轮在响。
lines.en: It cools in my hand; time's gears are turning.
I set it straight on the stone.

lines.zh: 把它放进表壳，能停住一刻。
lines.en: Tucked in my casing, it can stop a moment.
I close my fingers slowly.
It will return to the earth in the end.

lines.zh: 沙漏翻过来，你的那份漏完了。
lines.en: The hourglass turns; your share has run out.
I've counted every second of you.

lines.zh: 我这身四米，焊的是时间。
lines.en: Four meters of me, welding time itself.
This won't come quickly.

lines.zh: 你站着的地方，我已经算好。
lines.en: I've already computed where you stand.
I square my body slowly.
There's no one else here.

lines.zh: 我的影子量过你退的路。
lines.en: My shadow has measured your retreat.
The countdown hits zero. I begin.
I preside over this fight.
I see every second of you.

lines.zh: 时间在我手里，被焊住了。
lines.en: Time is welded shut in my hands.
I stand on your path.
Stay in this moment. Don't move.
I open my palm.
Now is that moment.
Time has started moving.
One step, one second.

lines.zh: 我的脚步和秒针一个节拍。
lines.en: My steps keep time with the second hand.
Wherever you go, I arrive first.
I calculate where you'll retreat.

lines.zh: 四格高的躯体，六点护甲。
lines.en: A four-block frame with sixteen armor.
I raise both hands slowly.
Time slows in my hands.
I hear your rapid breathing.

lines.zh: 这地方每一寸我都量过。
lines.en: I've measured every inch here.
Time moves forward, and so do I.
You're in my range.

lines.zh: 我等着，时间站在我这边。
lines.en: I wait — time is on my side.

lines.zh: 你的逃跑路线只有一条。
lines.en: You have only one escape route.
I've already blocked it.
The air is growing thick.
My gears mesh and I lean in.
I can afford to wait for this blow.
One more tick of the second hand.
Good, right here.

lines.zh: 我抬手很慢，像在拨时间。
lines.en: I raise my hand slowly, as if turning time.
But you'll see it come down.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，地面开了。
lines.en: My fist falls and the ground splits.

lines.zh: 横扫过去，风都慢了半拍。
lines.en: My sweep makes the air lag half a beat.

lines.zh: 我这一拳，把时间都砸慢了。
lines.en: My punch slows even time.
Slow, but unavoidable.
Light shoots from the faces of my clocks.
My hand closes and time freezes.

lines.zh: 时间在你身上停顿了一下。
lines.en: Time stuttered on you.
I push you away, unhurried.
Debris hung in the air for an instant.
My armor strikes sparks.
This blow falls on your flank.

lines.zh: 我抬手的动作，慢得像一年。
lines.en: My raised hand moves slowly as a year.
The shadow on the ground moved.
I stand and pursue no further.

lines.zh: 表盘裂开，我从缝里走出。
lines.en: The dial cracks; I step out of the seam.
The air stalls and I appear.
The Timewelder, standing here.
The clocks on me begin to turn.

lines.zh: 我落地时，尘土悬了一下。
lines.en: As I land, the dust hesitates.
This span of time is mine.

lines.zh: 我从很远的地方被叫来。
lines.en: I was called from very far away.
I straighten slowly, very tall.
All sound around grows light.
The hands stop in my palm.

lines.zh: 你不该在这个时刻出现。
lines.en: You shouldn't have appeared at this hour.
The bell rings first, then I appear.

lines.zh: 这里的每一秒都有重量。
lines.en: Every second here has weight.
I lift my head as the bell tolls.

lines.zh: 我身上的齿轮开始咬合。
lines.en: The gears on me begin to mesh.
I lift one foot and set it down.

lines.zh: 空气里全是金属的味道。
lines.en: The air tastes of metal.

lines.zh: 我从远处一步跨到这里。
lines.en: I crossed here in a single step.
I have no name for you to call.

lines.zh: 我站定，周围的声响收了。
lines.en: I stand, and the sounds around withdraw.

lines.zh: 火焰烤着我的金属，泛出红光。
lines.en: Fire heats my metal until it glows.

lines.zh: 我落地很重，地面凹下去。
lines.en: I land heavily and the ground dents.

lines.zh: 水进了我的缝隙，我沉了。
lines.en: Water fills my seams and I sink.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的甲片掀开一角。
lines.en: The blast pries up a corner of my plate.

lines.zh: 一枚投射物嵌在我的肩甲上。
lines.en: A projectile lodges in my pauldron.

lines.zh: 这股咒力想让我的钟停下来。
lines.en: This magic tries to stop my clocks.
My power dwindles bit by bit.

lines.zh: 雷把我身上的钟都打乱了。
lines.en: Lightning scatters the turning of my clocks.
There's no time here to pass.
